_why: THE LIST OF FORKS THE SPECS EXPECT, AND HOW EACH ONE COMES BACK.
Phase 0 of the extraction (doc 82 F3) found one fork unbuilt and nothing
noticing, and recommended that 'which forks must exist, and which must be
BUILT' be a written list rather than whatever happens to be on this machine.
Phase 4 forced the issue: with hacks/ present but holding only the game, the
spec lint failed 27 times, because its guard was all-or-nothing -- if hacks/
existed at all, every fork had to.
That guard exists to stop a TYPO in symbols_from becoming a silent skip, and
that is worth keeping. But 'this fixture has not been regenerated on this
machine' is not a typo. This file separates the two: a fork named here and
absent SKIPS with the command that rebuilds it; a fork NOT named here is a
Fixtures are disposable by design. Each is a throwaway fork built to walk
into one specific wall on purpose, and each is regenerated by its own tool --
so none of them is backed by a patch, and none of them needs to be.

reps.regenerate: new_hack.py reps && patch -p1 < patches/reps.patch && restore patches/assets/reps/
reps.note: The actual game. Its patch IS its only tracked copy -- see patches/README.md.

audio.note: The five-PCM-voice ceiling, and the discovery that ordinary map music is already over it.

cliffs.note: The map-size ceiling and the 16-slot spawn window, each walked off with its own control.

climbcliffs.note: Field-move id space: inserting ahead of an existing move silently re-gates it on a different badge.

palettes.note: The 16 dynamic sprite-palette slots; past them a sprite renders fully, in someone else's colours.

freesave.note: Save-layout change read by three builds of one tree; a size-preserving edit loads, validates and lies.

studio.note: Build progress as a playable ROM, driven from studio/manifest.json.

proofhack.regenerate: hand-made: fork the pin, edit sStarterMon's middle entry to CHARMANDER, build
proofhack.note: Fork discrimination: proves a spec resolves against the ROM it was actually given.

symshift.regenerate: hand-made: fork the pin, insert 8 bytes of .rodata, build
symshift.note: Moves 17,085 symbols, so the .sym genuinely differs -- the counterfactual for --sym defaulting.

e1bug.regenerate: hand-made: fork the pin and build unmodified

e1fix.regenerate: hand-made: fork the pin, apply the E1 one-line fix, build
e1fix.note: The paired fixed arm for E1.

redproof.note: Referenced by no spec as of 2026-08-06. Kept because the directory existed; delete it if it stays unreferenced.
